signature: Unable to preventDefault inside passive event listener invocation.
message: Unable to preventDefault inside passive event listener invocation. — 30 occurrences in the renderer console section of one host crash log, at a hashed app-shell chunk (index-BXV-oxvX.js:172). Pure renderer warning; the app keeps working, but the intended gesture suppression never happens.

signature: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.
message: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications. — one occurrence per boot in the renderer console; a resize observer callback mutates the size it observes, so the loop is re-queued and dropped.

signature: Sidebar Session opening failed · Session reference is released
message: Sidebar: Session opening failed: Session reference "5c51f4ea-..." is released — the sidebar tried to open a session whose reference had already been released; the failure is caught and surfaced as a UI error, host unaffected.

signature: client module revision mismatch · fetch failed
message: cannot answer /plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules/client.js&rev=0000000000ff at the revision the app serves now: fetch failed; asking the app's own route — after a hot reload the served client bundle revision no longer matches what the page asks for; falls back to the app route, some entries stay stale until a real reload. Also 6x 'the press was answered as failed and the page never said what it did' on 2026-10-28T04:20 in the same log.

signature: session store quarantined · unreadable session file
message: ~/.dsh/sessions-quarantine/2026-10-25-Pet/ holds 2 session dirs (session-8be71fcf, session-7d914680) moved out of ~/.dsh/sessions — the store quarantined sessions it could not read rather than deleting them. Date dir is the only timestamp evidence.

signature: Cannot read properties of undefined · tools.prepare
message: External corroboration (GitHub discussion deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#1337, dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, Windows 11, web profile): a profile-hoisted second copy of @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools makes the per-module scheduler Symbol mismatch, so the first tool call of a turn dies with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" and the dangling tool_calls make the session un-resumable: 'An assistant message with tool_calls must be followed by tool messages' (400).
